name: io.github.dokun1/confidence-picks
description: NFL confidence-pool picks, standings and dues for confidence-picks.com. Read your pools and the week's slate, submit a confidence ladder, and (as a group admin) manage dues.

environment_variables.name: CONFIDENCE_PICKS_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Personal access token minted at confidence-picks.com under Profile → AI client access (cp_live_…).

environment_variables.name: CONFIDENCE_PICKS_API
environment_variables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.confidence-picks.com.
